name: design-os-knowledge-builder
description: Ontology-first knowledge packs: claims with verifiable sources (frozen captures checked by sha256 and quote) and a ledger-backed stopping gate.

interface.shortDescription: Ontology-first knowledge packs: claims with verifiable sources (frozen captures checked by sha256 and quote) and a ledger-backed stopping gate.
interface.longDescription: Build knowledge packs from web pages and documents: freeze each source, promote evidence into claims that quote it, let `verify` check every quote, and let a ledger-backed stopping gate say when research is enough. The `es-knowledge-forge` skill teaches Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, and Antigravity the workflow.
defaultPrompt: Build an ontology-first knowledge pack on <topic>: freeze the sources, promote claims, cite them from a document, then run the stopping gate.
Check this knowledge pack: run verify --claims and pack check, and list the claims no document cites.
Add a claim to this pack from a verified evidence atom and cite it in the concept document.
